prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1045; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the claimant in connection with the rear-end collision that occurred involving your insured. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is now receiving medical care, and we are handling all aspects of the claim on their behalf. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy covering your insured at the time of the collision, along with a copy of the declarations page. We also ask that you confirm in writing whether any excess or umbrella coverage applies.

Please take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data, repair and appraisal records, witness information, and any electronic communications. Routine destruction or alteration of such materials should be suspended until this matter is fully resolved. We look forward to your prompt written response.
